thread:
maya: quick heads-up — ran a RoPE 'frequency-warp' sweep across Mixtral + Qwen on the longctx branch, saw a perf cliff and kv-slot growth after ~8k tokens. attaching profiler snippet.

alex: can you paste profiler? small paste ok

maya: ```
perf: kernel_select: MixtralFusedAttn v2 -> fallback CPU copy at step 8123
kv_cache: resident_slots=16384 -> 24789 (+51%)
batcher: mean_batch=4 -> 1.2 after cliff
latency_p50: 48ms -> 210ms
```

ravi: sounds like kernel fallback due to head-dim mismatch + seqlen, might be exceeding fused kernel safe range. which RoPE variant? linear or yarn?

maya: primarily NTK with a small linear control. cliff only on NTK on mixtral-arch. Llama and Mistral stable.

sophia: did you check head_count vs kv_width? Mixtral has weird head-kv packing when heads%8 != 0, can force head-slice config.

alex: try forcing kernel_selector=prefer_fused and limit seqlen window in runtime, and run with batcher_override=max_batch=8,early_evict=true

maya: did that — infra-bot rolled a canary.

infra-bot: deploy canary 2024-06-25T15:12Z -> ok

infra-bot: Canary result: latency normalized p50 55ms, p95 180ms, kv_slots stable at 16500

ravi: improvement but p95 still high. maybe prefix-evict heuristics not kicking in due to NTK freq-warp scaling. Add a KV slot trim per request older_than=6k

sophia: also log perplexity change — i saw a 2.3 perplexity jump on Qwen when switching from linear->ntk at scale 1.4

maya: notes: Qwen safe-range for NTK slope <=1.25, Mixtral <=1.1, Llama tolerates up to 1.6. I'm going to add model-safe-range table to runtime config.

alex: thanks — can you open a tiny PR with a flag to auto-fallback ropescale beyond safe-range? add metrics: rope_scale_used, kv_evicted_count

maya: on it. will also add a micro-benchmark script for longctx stability: tools/ropexp/rope_warp_smoke.sh

ravi: ping me when PR is ready. we should also add a batching heuristic: if mean_batch<2 and latency spikes, temporarily increase batch wait to 8ms.

sophia: +1. also add note: avoid forcing fused kernels for Qwen when head_dim%32!=0; prefer tiled kernel

maya: tl;dr: NTK frequency-warp exposes a kernel selector gap + KV leak at high seqlens on Mixtral/Qwen. mitigation: safe-range per-model, early eviction tweak, kernel preference, and batcher threshold. filing follow-ups.

alex: :thumbsup:

maya: filing thread — will link PR and perf graphs here when ready.
